The driver's hands appear slightly fused with the steering wheel, lacking distinct finger definition. The grip looks unnatural and somewhat blurry.
The rear right wheel is partially obscured by shadow but appears to have an inconsistent elliptical shape compared to the front wheel, suggesting slight geometric warping.
